column1: # Game rules whose id differs from 1.21.1's, per version. Read by mc_game_rule
# (scripts/lib.sh), which deploy.sh's enforcement block calls with the 1.21.1
# name; a version with no rows here keeps the 1.21.1 names.
#   version  the Minecraft version the row applies to
#   id       the version's game rule (the minecraft:game_rule registry)
#   values   "-" keeps the value; else old=new pairs, comma-separated
# The 26.3 ids are the registry report of the 26.3 server jar. doFireTick
# became a radius: 128 (the 26.3 default) spreads fire as before, 0 stops it.
